title: Translating messages while the draft is kept
description: The original phrase stays alongside until the author picks the version to send.

blocks.text: When editing a short message, what has been typed must not be lost. A translation that arrives late should not overwrite a new thought.

quote.text: I really like the application. It works well. I mainly use the keyboard because it translates messages really well on apps like Whatsapp. I just really wish it had the swipe feature.

blocks.text: Keep the original, the chosen direction and the separate versions of the result. Insert the translation only after it has been confirmed.
Test deletion, undo, switching apps and a network failure. A built-in keyboard has to preserve the usual control over text.
